id_convention: All LLD-02 persistent entity/event/relationship identities use lowercase canonical UUIDv4 text from DomainIdFactory; descriptive/business values are never primary keys.
table_mode: Every table in this leaf is SQLite STRICT.

tables.name: contacts
columns: lifecycle_state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(lifecycle_state IN ('active','archived'))
revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(revision>0)
rules: equal names are allowed
name/name_match_key never authorize merge/global uniqueness
archived Contact remains historically queryable but excluded from new-active selectors
BEFORE DELETE raises REFERENCE_DELETE_FORBIDDEN

tables.name: contact_channels
tables.purpose: reusable Contact communication/matching attributes; Beta 1.0 channel kind is email
columns: contact_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES contacts(contact_id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
lifecycle_state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(lifecycle_state IN ('active','archived'))
revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(revision>0)
rules: Beta 1.0 persists only email channels; another kind requires forward migration + policy/version support
value_text passes ContactChannelPolicy storage validation; match_key uses governed MatchingNormalizer
equal normalized channel values are allowed and may produce ambiguity
channel identity independent from Contact/authentication
BEFORE DELETE raises CONTACT_CHANNEL_DELETE_FORBIDDEN
archived channel rejects further ordinary UPDATE; active->archived and active value/revision correction remain governed transitions

tables.name: contact_affiliations
tables.purpose: explicit affiliation history under one continuous Contact identity
columns: contact_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES contacts(contact_id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
customer_org_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES customer_organizations(customer_org_id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
is_current INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(is_current IN (0,1))
closed_at_utc INTEGER CHECK(closed_at_utc IS NULL OR closed_at_utc>=opened_at_utc)
opened_command_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES command_receipts(command_id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
closed_command_id TEXT REFERENCES command_receipts(command_id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
CHECK((is_current=1 AND closed_at_utc IS NULL AND closed_command_id IS NULL) OR (is_current=0 AND closed_at_utc IS NOT NULL AND closed_command_id IS NOT NULL))
rules: at most one current row per Contact via partial unique index
changing affiliation closes previous current row and inserts new row in one UnitOfWork
BEFORE UPDATE permits only current->historical closure setting closed fields while immutable relationship/opening fields remain unchanged; historical rows reject further UPDATE
BEFORE DELETE raises CONTACT_AFFILIATION_HISTORY_APPEND_ONLY
operational records preserve organization-at-use context in owning domain

tables.name: dispatch_locations
columns: address_mode TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(address_mode IN ('standalone','site_derived'))
lifecycle_state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(lifecycle_state IN ('active','archived'))
revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(revision>0)
CHECK((address_mode='standalone' AND standalone_address_text IS NOT NULL AND length(standalone_address_text)>0) OR (address_mode='site_derived' AND standalone_address_text IS NULL))
rules: no Customer ownership/preference column
Site relationship owned by LLD-08 and not duplicated here
site_derived current address resolves through SiteDispatchAddressProvider; historical snapshots belong LLD-07
operation role never stored on location master
BEFORE DELETE raises REFERENCE_DELETE_FORBIDDEN

tables.name: reference_lifecycle_events
tables.purpose: append-only reference lifecycle occurrence evidence distinct from application audit
columns: target_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(target_type IN ('customer_organization','contact','dispatch_location'))
event_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(event_type IN ('created','archived','reactivated','descriptive_corrected'))
command_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES command_receipts(command_id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
rules: target uses immutable evidence identity rather than destructive FK so required history may survive future exceptional deletion authority
BEFORE UPDATE/DELETE raise REFERENCE_LIFECYCLE_APPEND_ONLY
accepted lifecycle events referenced from corresponding LLD-01 audit event via audit_event_results

indexes: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_contact_current_affiliation ON contact_affiliations(contact_id) WHERE is_current=1
cross_module_schema_rule: LLD-08 creates/owns Site↔Dispatch Location relationship with UNIQUE constraints on both Site and dispatch_location_id; LLD-02 never adds site_id/customer_org_id shortcut to dispatch_locations.
verification: LLD-01 exact-schema verification includes these STRICT tables, indexes and protection triggers once the LLD-02 migration is accepted.
